# SCHEMA is hq_T's shared eight-column one (row ladder-forms-column-and-forms-check-every-declared-form-and-
# pair-has-a-witness): RUNG CONSTRUCT REFERENCE FORMS PAIRS WITNESS_ORIGIN STATUS NOTE. FORMS is |-separated,
# one entry per form the reference lists; PAIRS is |-separated lower-rung CONSTRUCT slugs this construct must
# be combined with in the combinations phase (sibling row prolog-ladder-feature-combinations-after-isolation).
# Expected origins: isolation ladder__<rung>_<construct>_<form> · combinations ladder__<rung>_<construct>_with_<lower>.
# RUNGS come from ARCH-PROLOG-BYRD-BOX-TRANSLATION.md sec E (rungs 0-18, sovereign). Rungs 14-18 were added
# here first (ceo, corpus 6e84528bf, on Lon 2026-09-05 "ensure that each ladder is full and complete") and
# BACK-FILLED into sec E by hq_C 2026-09-05 -- until then this header cited an authority that did not
# contain five of its own rungs. FORMS come from the
# language reference (ISO/IEC 13211-1 clause numbers cited per row, SWI where the standard is silent), NOT from
# what SCRIP happens to implement -- a census that enumerated the implementation could never name a gap.
# WITNESS_ORIGIN records what EXISTS TODAY, measured from corpus/tests/prolog/ALL.csv on 2026-09-04, not assumed.
# STATUS: BUILT = every declared form witnessed · PARTIAL = some · DECLARED = none · RED = witnessed and failing.
# There are 32 ladder__rung* origins across rungs 00-12 today and 0 rows read BUILT: the pre-convention names
# bundle several forms into one witness (ladder__rung01_fact_rule is fact AND rule; ladder__rung05_once_forall_
# ignore is three constructs). That gap is the row's work, and naming it is the point of this file.
# The three RED rows are measured, not predicted (hq_C 2026-09-04, SCRIP 4a4cbdbf4 merge candidate + swipl):
# retract/1 and clause/2 do not lower at all, and abolish/1 answers WRONG at rc=0 -- see the parent baton
# prolog-rung-10b-assert-retract-abolish-clause-the-dynamic-database. A form that exposes a defect stays RED in
# the master and becomes a class row on its rung; THERE IS NO XFAIL (Lon 2026-09-03).
